class.name: SiONDriver
class.brief_description: A software synthesizer driver for creating and playing music using MML (Music Macro Language) in Godot games.
class.description:
SiONDriver is a powerful software synthesizer that allows you to create and play music directly in your Godot games using MML (Music Macro Language). It provides real-time audio synthesis with support for various sound chips, effects, and advanced audio features.
[b]Key Features:[/b] • Real-time MML music synthesis and playback • Support for multiple sound chip emulations (FM, PSG, PCM, etc.) • Built-in audio effects and processing • Background music with fade transitions • Note-by-note playback control • Audio rendering for file export • Performance monitoring and statistics
[b]Basic Usage:[/b] [codeblock] # Create a SiONDriver instance var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
# Compile and play MML music var mml = "t120 l8 cdefgabc>c" var data = driver.compile(mml) driver.play(data) [/codeblock]
[b]Important Notes:[/b] • Only one SiONDriver instance should exist at a time (unless multiple drivers are explicitly allowed) • The driver must be added to the scene tree to function properly • Buffer length can only be 2048, 4096, or 8192 samples • Only stereo (2 channels) and mono (1 channel) output are supported • Sample rate is fixed at 44100 Hz
[b]MML Syntax:[/b] MML (Music Macro Language) is a text-based music notation system. Basic commands include: • [code]t[/code] - Set tempo (BPM) • [code]l[/code] - Set default note length • [code]o[/code] - Set octave • [code]cdefgab[/code] - Note names (C, D, E, F, G, A, B) • [code]r[/code] - Rest • [code]<[/code] and [code]>[/code] - Octave up/down • [code]v[/code] - Set volume • [code]@[/code] - Set voice/instrument
For more advanced MML features, refer to the SiON documentation and examples.

method.name: clear_data
method.description:
Clears the currently loaded music data. This frees memory but doesn't affect playback.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
var data = driver.compile("t120 l8 cdefgab>c") driver.play(data)
# Clear data to free memory driver.clear_data() [/codeblock]

method.name: compile
method.description:
Compiles MML (Music Macro Language) text into playable music data. This method parses the MML string and creates a SiONData object that can be played or rendered.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]mml[/code] - MML string containing music notation
[b]Returns:[/b] A SiONData object containing the compiled music
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
# Simple melody var mml = "t120 l8 cdefgab>c" var data = driver.compile(mml) driver.play(data)
# More complex example with multiple tracks var mml = """ #TRACK1 t120 l8 cdefgab>c #TRACK2 t120 l4 o3 cegc """ var data = driver.compile(mml) driver.play(data) [/codeblock]
[b]Note:[/b] This method is synchronous and will block until compilation is complete. For long MML strings, consider using [method queue_compile] instead.

method.name: create
method.description:
Creates a new SiONDriver instance. This is the recommended way to create a driver since Godot doesn't expose constructors directly.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]buffer_size[/code] - Audio buffer size in samples. Must be 2048, 4096, or 8192. Larger buffers provide better performance but higher latency. • [code]channel_num[/code] - Number of audio channels (1 for mono, 2 for stereo) • [code]sample_rate[/code] - Audio sample rate in Hz (currently only 44100 is supported) • [code]bitrate[/code] - Audio bitrate (0 for float format)
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] # Create a driver with default settings var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
# Create a driver with custom buffer size var driver = SiONDriver.create(4096, 2, 44100, 0) add_child(driver) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_buffer_length
method.description:
Returns the audio buffer length in samples.
[b]Returns:[/b] Buffer length (2048, 4096, or 8192)
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create(4096) add_child(driver)
print("Buffer length: ", driver.get_buffer_length()) # 4096 [/codeblock]

method.name: get_channel_num
method.description:
Returns the number of audio output channels.
[b]Returns:[/b] Number of channels (1 for mono, 2 for stereo)
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create(2048, 2) add_child(driver)
print("Channels: ", driver.get_channel_num()) # 2 [/codeblock]

method.name: get_compiling_time
method.description:
Returns the time taken for the last compilation in milliseconds.
[b]Returns:[/b] Compilation time in milliseconds
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
var data = driver.compile("t120 l8 cdefgab>c") print("Compilation took: ", driver.get_compiling_time(), "ms") [/codeblock]

method.name: get_data
get_processing_time
method.description:
Returns the average audio processing time per second in milliseconds.
[b]Returns:[/b] Average processing time in milliseconds
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c")
# Check processing time after some playback await get_tree().create_timer(1.0).timeout print("Average processing time: ", driver.get_processing_time(), "ms") [/codeblock]

method.name: get_rendering_time
method.description:
Returns the time taken for the last rendering operation in milliseconds.
[b]Returns:[/b] Rendering time in milliseconds
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
var buffer = driver.render("t120 l8 cdefgab>c", 44100 * 5, 2) print("Rendering took: ", driver.get_rendering_time(), "ms") [/codeblock]

method.name: get_sample_rate
method.description:
Returns the audio sample rate in Hz.
[b]Returns:[/b] Sample rate (currently always 44100)
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
print("Sample rate: ", driver.get_sample_rate()) # 44100.0 [/codeblock]

method.name: get_track_count
method.description:
Returns the number of currently active tracks. Only works when streaming.
[b]Returns:[/b] Number of active tracks
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver) driver.stream()
driver.note_on(60) driver.note_on(64) print("Active tracks: ", driver.get_track_count()) # 2 [/codeblock]

method.name: get_volume
method.description:
Returns the current master volume level.
[b]Returns:[/b] Volume level between 0.0 and 1.0
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
print("Current volume: ", driver.get_volume()) # 1.0 driver.set_volume(0.5) print("New volume: ", driver.get_volume()) # 0.5 [/codeblock]

method.name: get_bpm
method.description:
Returns the current BPM (beats per minute) of the sequencer.
[b]Returns:[/b] BPM value (1-4000)
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c") print("Current BPM: ", driver.get_bpm()) # 120.0 [/codeblock]

method.name: get_max_track_count
method.description:
Returns the maximum number of tracks that can be active simultaneously.
[b]Returns:[/b] Maximum track count
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
print("Max tracks: ", driver.get_max_track_count()) driver.set_max_track_count(16) print("New max tracks: ", driver.get_max_track_count()) [/codeblock]

method.name: is_paused
method.description:
Returns whether audio playback is currently paused.
[b]Returns:[/b] true if paused, false otherwise
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c") print("Paused: ", driver.is_paused()) # false
driver.pause() print("Paused: ", driver.is_paused()) # true
driver.resume() print("Paused: ", driver.is_paused()) # false [/codeblock]

method.name: is_streaming
method.description:
Returns whether the driver is currently streaming audio.
[b]Returns:[/b] true if streaming, false otherwise
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
print("Streaming: ", driver.is_streaming()) # false driver.stream() print("Streaming: ", driver.is_streaming()) # true driver.stop() print("Streaming: ", driver.is_streaming()) # false [/codeblock]

method.name: note_off
method.description:
Stops playing a specific note or all notes in a track.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]note[/code] - MIDI note number to stop (-1 to stop all notes in the track) • [code]track_id[/code] - Track ID to target (0 for all tracks) • [code]delay[/code] - Delay before stopping in 1/16th beats • [code]quantize[/code] - Quantization grid size in 1/16th beats • [code]stop_immediately[/code] - Whether to stop immediately or let the note fade out
[b]Returns:[/b] Array of affected SiMMLTrack objects
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver) driver.stream()
# Play a note driver.note_on(60)
# Stop it after 2 seconds await get_tree().create_timer(2.0).timeout driver.note_off(60)
# Stop all notes in track 1 driver.note_off(-1, 1) [/codeblock]

method.name: note_on
method.description:
Plays a single note. The driver must be streaming (call [method stream] first) to use this method.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]note[/code] - MIDI note number (0-127, where 60 is middle C) • [code]voice[/code] - SiONVoice object defining the instrument sound (optional) • [code]length[/code] - Note length in 1/16th beats (0 = use default length) • [code]delay[/code] - Delay before playing in 1/16th beats • [code]quantize[/code] - Quantization grid size in 1/16th beats • [code]track_id[/code] - Unique identifier for the track • [code]disposable[/code] - Whether the track should be automatically cleaned up
[b]Returns:[/b] The created SiMMLTrack object
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver) driver.stream()
# Play a C major chord driver.note_on(60) # C driver.note_on(64) # E driver.note_on(67) # G
# Play with custom voice and timing var voice = SiONVoice.new() voice.set_module_type(SiONModuleType.MODULE_FM) driver.note_on(72, voice, 4.0, 2.0) # High C, 1 beat, 1/8 beat delay [/codeblock]
[b]Note:[/b] Use [method note_off] to stop notes, or they will play until the end of their length.

method.name: note_on_with_bend
method.description:
Plays a note with pitch bending from one note to another.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]note[/code] - Starting MIDI note number • [code]note_to[/code] - Target MIDI note number for the bend • [code]bend_length[/code] - Duration of the pitch bend in 1/16th beats • [code]voice[/code] - SiONVoice object defining the instrument sound (optional) • [code]length[/code] - Total note length in 1/16th beats • [code]delay[/code] - Delay before playing in 1/16th beats • [code]quantize[/code] - Quantization grid size in 1/16th beats • [code]track_id[/code] - Unique identifier for the track • [code]disposable[/code] - Whether the track should be automatically cleaned up
[b]Returns:[/b] The created SiMMLTrack object
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver) driver.stream()
# Play a note that bends from C to E driver.note_on_with_bend(60, 64, 4.0) # C to E over 1 beat [/codeblock]

method.name: pause
method.description:
Pauses audio playback while keeping the current state. Use [method resume] to continue playback from where it was paused.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c")
# Pause when player presses P if Input.is_action_just_pressed("pause_music"): driver.pause()
# Resume when player presses R if Input.is_action_just_pressed("resume_music"): driver.resume() [/codeblock]

method.name: play
method.description:
Plays compiled music data. The data can be either a SiONData object or an MML string (which will be compiled automatically).
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]data[/code] - SiONData object or MML string to play • [code]reset_effector[/code] - Whether to reset audio effects before playing
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
# Play compiled data var mml = "t120 l8 cdefgab>c" var data = driver.compile(mml) driver.play(data)
# Play MML string directly driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c")
# Play with effects preserved driver.play(data, false) [/codeblock]
[b]Note:[/b] This method automatically starts streaming if not already active. Use [method stop] to stop playback.

method.name: queue_compile
method.description:
Adds a compilation job to the processing queue. This is useful for compiling long MML strings without blocking the main thread.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]mml[/code] - MML string to compile
[b]Returns:[/b] Number of jobs in the queue
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
# Queue compilation var job_id = driver.queue_compile("t120 l8 cdefgab>c")
# Start processing the queue driver.start_queue()
# Connect to the completion signal driver.compilation_finished.connect(_on_compilation_finished)
func _on_compilation_finished(data): print("Compilation finished!") driver.play(data) [/codeblock]

method.name: queue_render
method.description:
Adds a rendering job to the processing queue. This is useful for rendering long pieces without blocking the main thread.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]data[/code] - SiONData object or MML string to render • [code]buffer_size[/code] - Size of the output buffer in samples • [code]buffer_channel_num[/code] - Number of channels in output (1 for mono, 2 for stereo) • [code]reset_effector[/code] - Whether to reset audio effects before rendering
[b]Returns:[/b] Number of jobs in the queue
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
# Queue rendering var job_id = driver.queue_render("t120 l8 cdefgab>c", 44100 * 10, 2)
# Start processing the queue driver.start_queue()
# Connect to the completion signal driver.render_finished.connect(_on_render_finished)
func _on_render_finished(buffer): print("Rendering finished! Buffer size: ", buffer.size()) # Save buffer to file or use it elsewhere [/codeblock]

method.name: render
method.description:
Renders music data to an audio buffer. This is useful for exporting music to files or creating audio data for other purposes.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]data[/code] - SiONData object or MML string to render • [code]buffer_size[/code] - Size of the output buffer in samples • [code]buffer_channel_num[/code] - Number of channels in output (1 for mono, 2 for stereo) • [code]reset_effector[/code] - Whether to reset audio effects before rendering
[b]Returns:[/b] PackedFloat64Array containing the rendered audio samples
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
# Render a simple melody var mml = "t120 l8 cdefgab>c" var audio_buffer = driver.render(mml, 44100 * 5, 2) # 5 seconds of stereo audio
# Save to file (you'd need to implement the file saving logic) print("Rendered ", audio_buffer.size(), " samples") [/codeblock]
[b]Note:[/b] This method is synchronous and will block until rendering is complete. For long pieces, consider using [method queue_render] instead.

method.name: reset
method.description:
Resets all tracks to their initial state without stopping playback. This is useful for restarting sequences or clearing track states.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver) driver.stream()
# Play some notes driver.note_on(60) driver.note_on(64)
# Reset tracks (stops all notes) driver.reset()
# Play new notes driver.note_on(67) driver.note_on(72) [/codeblock]

method.name: resume
method.description:
Resumes audio playback after being paused with [method pause].
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] # See [method pause] for complete example [/codeblock]

method.name: sample_on
method.description:
Plays a PCM sample by its index number. Samples must be registered using [method set_pcm_wave] or [method set_sampler_wave] first.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]sample_number[/code] - Index of the registered sample • [code]length[/code] - Playback length in 1/16th beats (0 = play full sample) • [code]delay[/code] - Delay before playing in 1/16th beats • [code]quantize[/code] - Quantization grid size in 1/16th beats • [code]track_id[/code] - Unique identifier for the track • [code]disposable[/code] - Whether the track should be automatically cleaned up
[b]Returns:[/b] The created SiMMLTrack object
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver) driver.stream()
# Register a PCM sample (you need actual audio data) var audio_data = load("res://sounds/drum.wav") driver.set_pcm_wave(0, audio_data, 60) # Register as sample 0
# Play the sample driver.sample_on(0, 2.0) # Play for 1/8 beat [/codeblock]

method.name: sequence_on
method.description:
Plays a specific sequence from compiled SiONData. This allows you to play individual tracks or sections of music.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]data[/code] - SiONData object containing the sequence to play • [code]voice[/code] - SiONVoice object to apply to all tracks in the sequence (optional) • [code]length[/code] - Playback length in 1/16th beats (0 = play full sequence) • [code]delay[/code] - Delay before playing in 1/16th beats • [code]quantize[/code] - Quantization grid size in 1/16th beats • [code]track_id[/code] - Unique identifier for the sequence tracks • [code]disposable[/code] - Whether the tracks should be automatically cleaned up
[b]Returns:[/b] Array of created SiMMLTrack objects
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver) driver.stream()
# Compile music with multiple tracks var mml = """ #TRACK1 t120 l8 cdefgab>c #TRACK2 t120 l4 o3 cegc """ var data = driver.compile(mml)
# Play only the melody track var tracks = driver.sequence_on(data, null, 0, 0, 1, 1) [/codeblock]

method.name: sequence_off
method.description:
Stops all sequence tracks with the specified track ID.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]track_id[/code] - Track ID to stop • [code]delay[/code] - Delay before stopping in 1/16th beats • [code]quantize[/code] - Quantization grid size in 1/16th beats • [code]stop_with_reset[/code] - Whether to reset the sequence state
[b]Returns:[/b] Array of affected SiMMLTrack objects
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver) driver.stream()
# Start a sequence var data = driver.compile("t120 l8 cdefgab>c") driver.sequence_on(data, null, 0, 0, 1, 1)
# Stop it after 5 seconds await get_tree().create_timer(5.0).timeout driver.sequence_off(1) [/codeblock]

method.name: stop
method.description:
Stops all audio playback and streaming. This method clears all tracks, stops the audio player, and resets the driver state.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
# Play some music driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c")
# Stop after 5 seconds await get_tree().create_timer(5.0).timeout driver.stop() [/codeblock]

method.name: stream
method.description:
Starts audio streaming without playing any music. This is useful when you want to use note-by-note playback methods like [method note_on] and [method sample_on].
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]reset_effector[/code] - Whether to reset audio effects
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
# Start streaming for interactive music driver.stream()
# Now you can play individual notes driver.note_on(60) # Play middle C driver.note_on(64) # Play E driver.note_on(67) # Play G [/codeblock]

method.name: fade_in
method.description:
Gradually increases the volume from 0 to the current volume level over the specified time.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]time[/code] - Fade-in duration in seconds
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.set_volume(0.0) # Start silent driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c") driver.fade_in(2.0) # Fade in over 2 seconds [/codeblock]

method.name: fade_out
method.description:
Gradually decreases the volume from the current level to 0 over the specified time.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]time[/code] - Fade-out duration in seconds
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c")
# Fade out after 5 seconds await get_tree().create_timer(5.0).timeout driver.fade_out(3.0) # Fade out over 3 seconds [/codeblock]

members.member:
The current BPM (beats per minute) of the sequencer. This affects the timing of all music playback.
[b]Range:[/b] 1.0 to 4000.0
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.bpm = 120.0 # Set to 120 BPM driver.play("l8 cdefgab>c") # Play without tempo command [/codeblock]

The maximum number of tracks that can be active simultaneously. This limits memory usage and performance impact.
[b]Range:[/b] 1 or higher
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.max_track_count = 16 # Allow up to 16 simultaneous tracks driver.stream()
# Now you can play up to 16 notes at once for i in range(16): driver.note_on(60 + i) [/codeblock]

The master volume level for all audio output.
[b]Range:[/b] 0.0 to 1.0 (0.0 = silent, 1.0 = full volume)
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.volume = 0.5 # Set to 50% volume driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c")
# Gradually increase volume for i in range(10): driver.volume = i * 0.1 await get_tree().create_timer(0.1).timeout [/codeblock]

signal.name: bpm_changed
signal.description:
Emitted when the BPM changes during playback. This can happen due to tempo commands in MML or programmatic changes.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.bpm_changed.connect(_on_bpm_changed) driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c t180 l8 cdefgab>c")
func _on_bpm_changed(event): print("BPM changed to: ", driver.bpm) [/codeblock]

signal.name: compilation_finished
signal.description:
Emitted when a compilation job (from [method queue_compile]) is completed.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]data[/code] - The compiled SiONData object
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.compilation_finished.connect(_on_compilation_finished) driver.queue_compile("t120 l8 cdefgab>c") driver.start_queue()
func _on_compilation_finished(data): print("Compilation finished!") driver.play(data) [/codeblock]

signal.name: note_on_stream
signal.description:
Emitted when a note starts playing during streaming. This is useful for visual feedback or synchronization.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.note_on_stream.connect(_on_note_on) driver.stream() driver.note_on(60)
func _on_note_on(event): print("Note started: ", event.note) # Trigger visual effect or animation [/codeblock]

signal.name: render_finished
signal.description:
Emitted when a rendering job (from [method queue_render]) is completed.
[b]Parameters:[/b] • [code]buffer[/code] - The rendered audio buffer
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.render_finished.connect(_on_render_finished) driver.queue_render("t120 l8 cdefgab>c", 44100 * 5, 2) driver.start_queue()
func _on_render_finished(buffer): print("Rendering finished! Buffer size: ", buffer.size()) # Save buffer to file or use it elsewhere [/codeblock]

signal.name: sequence_finished
signal.description:
Emitted when a music sequence finishes playing.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.sequence_finished.connect(_on_sequence_finished) driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c")
func _on_sequence_finished(event): print("Music sequence finished!") # Play next song or loop driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c") [/codeblock]

signal.name: stream_started
signal.description:
Emitted when audio streaming begins. This happens when you call [method stream] or [method play].
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.stream_started.connect(_on_stream_started) driver.stream()
func _on_stream_started(event): print("Audio streaming started!") [/codeblock]

signal.name: stream_stopped
signal.description:
Emitted when audio streaming stops. This happens when you call [method stop] or when playback ends.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.stream_stopped.connect(_on_stream_stopped) driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c")
func _on_stream_stopped(event): print("Audio streaming stopped!") [/codeblock]

signal.name: streaming_beat
signal.description:
Emitted on each beat during streaming. Use [method set_beat_callback_interval] to control the frequency.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.streaming_beat.connect(_on_beat) driver.set_beat_callback_interval(1.0) # Every quarter note driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c")
func _on_beat(event): print("Beat!") # Sync animations or effects to the beat [/codeblock]

signal.name: timer_interval
signal.description:
Emitted at regular intervals during streaming. Use [method set_timer_interval] to control the frequency.
[b]Example:[/b] [codeblock] var driver = SiONDriver.create() add_child(driver)
driver.timer_interval.connect(_on_timer) driver.set_timer_interval(4.0) # Every 4 beats driver.play("t120 l8 cdefgab>c")
func _on_timer(): print("Timer interval!") # Perform periodic tasks [/codeblock]
